name: where-am-i
description: Shows which machine and repo a session runs in (Mac or the claude-code container, repo, branch, fork) in the status line, and nudges Claude when it reaches for the container from the Mac or runs a repo's tests on the wrong host.

hosts.title: Host labels
hosts.description: hostname-glob=label pairs, first match wins, e.g. claude-code*=🐧 claude-code. Unmatched: 🍎 Mac on macOS, 🐳 <host> in a container, 🐧 <host> elsewhere.

homes.title: Where each repo's dev work runs
homes.description: repo-glob=mac|container pairs. Running a build or test of a matching repo on the other kind of host adds a note for Claude.

containerTargets.title: SSH targets that mean the dev container or Unraid host
containerTargets.description: Words that, after ssh/scp/rsync on the Mac, mean work that belongs in an UnRAID SSH session instead.
